title: Career Roadmap · EV Mechanic
summary: An EV Mechanic inspects, services and repairs electric vehicles, focusing on electric motors, batteries, charging systems, power electronics, thermal management and vehicle diagnostics.

facts.Current degree: ITI Trades – Motor Vehicle / Diesel / Two-Wheeler / EV

blocks.text: Primary pathway
Core work
EV servicing • Battery diagnostics • Motor and controller systems • Charging faults • Electrical safety • Diagnostic tools.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Electrical fundamentals, workshop safety, vehicle systems, measurement and hand tools.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — EV systems
blocks.text: Electric motors, controllers, battery packs, battery management systems and charging systems.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Advanced skills
blocks.text: Diagnostic tools, regenerative braking, DC-DC converters, thermal management and fault analysis.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Supervised diagnostics, maintenance records, practical projects and apprenticeship applications.
DGT's Mechanic Electric Vehicle curriculum includes motor controllers, battery packs, battery management systems, charging and regenerative braking.
Directorate General of Training

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Create an EV service checklist • Map a low-voltage EV circuit • Practise fault diagnosis on a training rig • Compare charging-system components using safe demonstration equipment.

blocks.label: Safety
blocks.text: Do not open or work on high-voltage battery packs without appropriate training, isolation procedures, PPE and supervision.

blocks.text: EV training + experience → Battery Diagnostics / Service Technician.

blocks.label: Diagnostics route
blocks.text: Practical experience + electronics training → EV Diagnostic Technician.

blocks.label: Charging route
blocks.text: Electrical training and relevant authorization → EV Charging Equipment Service Technician.
